scope: first complete semantic pass, canonical ordinals 15577-15663

findings.source: Scammer: Ему выбили, прикинь, все зубы нахуй ХАХАХАХАХАХА.
findings.currentTarget: Scammer: I-au scos, închipuie-ți, toți dinții, futu-i mama mă-sii! HAHAHAHAHAHA.
findings.reason: Russian выбили says all of his brother’s teeth were knocked out by force; Romanian i-au scos says only that they were removed, losing the violent action in the anecdote.
findings.proposedTarget: Scammer: I-au făcut să-i sară toți dinții, închipuie-ți, futu-i mama mă-sii! HAHAHAHAHAHA.
